mapper.select: SELECT tdm14_task_type_id AS task_type_id , tdm14_task_class_cd AS task_class_code , f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm14_task_class_cd, tdm14_company_id, f_today())||'('||tdm14_task_class_cd||')' AS task_class_name , tdm14_task_type_cd AS task_type_code , tdm14_task_type_nm AS task_type_name , tdm14_use_yn AS use_yn FROM ( SELECT tdm14_task_type.* , SUBSTR(tdm14_task_type_cd,1,1) AS tdm14_task_class_cd FROM tdm14_task_type WHERE tdm14_task_type_id = #{taskTypeId} AND tdm14_company_id = #{companyId} ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm14_task_type ( tdm14_task_type_id, tdm14_company_id, tdm14_task_type_cd, tdm14_task_type_nm, tdm14_use_yn, tdm14_upd_nm, tdm14_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{taskTypeId}, #{companyId}, #{row.taskTypeCode}, #{row.taskTypeName}, #{row.useYn}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
